name: 1Zpresso J-Max
details: Hand grinder with external adjustment: 90 clicks per rotation (9 numbers × 10 clicks).

notes.moka: 1Zpresso groups moka pot with AeroPress and drip coffee maker.
notes.aeropress: 1Zpresso groups AeroPress, moka pot and drip coffee maker.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “J-Max Grind Setting Reference” chart (J-Max-Grind-setting-reference-20220721.jpg on that page), in clicks: Turkish 70–110, espresso 90–150, AeroPress/moka/drip coffee maker 180–240, siphon/pour over 240–300, French press 360–420.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
